description_en: Searches for cities, hotels, and popular keywords
description_zh: 使用该接口可以进行城市、酒店、热门关键词的搜索
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen hotel-suggest-v2 --city-code 330100 --keyword '万豪' --check-in 2024-05-15 --check-out 2024-06-04 --search-type 1 --btrip-user-id 1000 --x-acs-btrip-corp-token feth00jqwls --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: HotelSuggestV2

parameters.description_en: The keyword. Required when search_type is set to 0.
parameters.help_en: The keyword. Required when search_type is set to 0
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.description_en: The hotel check-in date in the format yyyy-MM-dd.
parameters.help_en: The hotel check-in date in the format yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.name: check_in

parameters.description_en: The hotel check-out date in the format yyyy-MM-dd.
parameters.help_en: The hotel check-out date in the format yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.name: check_out

parameters.description_en: The external user ID. If organization members are synchronized, use btripUserId. Otherwise, pass the userId corresponding to the distributor's own system user.
parameters.description_zh: 外部用户 Id（如果组织人员同步了，为 btripUserId。没有的话则需要传分销商自己系统用户对应的 userId）
parameters.help_en: The external user ID. If organization members are synchronized, use btripUserId. Otherwise, pass the userId corresponding to the distributor's own system user
parameters.help_zh: 外部用户 Id（如果组织人员同步了，为 btripUserId。没有的话则需要传分销商自己系统用户对应的 userId）
